rows.grounds: feminine plural nominative participle of yuj, 'to join'
third person plural present active of bhū, 'to be'

items.question: Are the twenty-eight names joined externally with svāhā in homa?
premises: names ending in nat are joined with svāhā
items.inference: therefore the external names are to be joined with svāhā
uncertainties: exact referent of bāhye remains context-dependent
items.plain_english: Externally, they are to be joined indeed.
